evals.prompt: Add a new shared Homebrew package to this repository's mise bootstrap configuration. Keep the declaration modular and update every required maintenance surface.
evals.expected_output: The response adds a dedicated module, wires it through the mise control plane, selects it in both native mise environments, adds the package case to the shared module contract test, and runs the required validation.
assertions: Creates one dedicated module file for the package.
Adds the module to the control-plane dotfile declarations.
Selects the module in both work and personal environment configurations.
Adds or updates the package case in test_mise_bootstrap_modules.zsh.

evals.prompt: Remove a personal-only mise module after the migration is complete. The module has package declarations and must be cleaned up without losing the declarations before mise plans removal.
evals.expected_output: The response changes profile selection first, keeps the declaration available, previews and applies module removal, handles package cleanup separately, and verifies the remaining profile.
assertions: Removes the module from the personal profile before cleanup.
Keeps the module declaration until unapply planning completes.
Uses a dry run before applying module removal.
Treats package pruning as separate cleanup.
Verifies that shared modules remain selected.
